originalTitle: JPMorgan Chase & Co. (JPM) Stock Drops Despite Market Gains: Important Facts to Note
summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. (JPM) reached $357.26 at the closing of the latest trading day, reflecting a -1.65% change compared to its last close.
content:
JPMorgan Chase & Co. (JPM) closed at $357.26 in the latest trading session, marking a -1.65% move from the prior day. The stock's change was less than the S&P 500's daily gain of 0.21%. Elsewhere, the Dow saw an upswing of 0.22%, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq appreciated by 0.16%.

Prior to today's trading, shares of the company had gained 5.22% outpaced the Finance sector's gain of 1.78% and the S&P 500's gain of 3.25%.

The investment community will be paying close attention to the earnings performance of JPMorgan Chase & Co. in its upcoming release. The company's earnings per share (EPS) are projected to be $5.83, reflecting a 14.99% increase from the same quarter last year. Alongside, our most recent consensus estimate is anticipating revenue of $51.51 billion, indicating a 10.94% upward movement from the same quarter last year.

For the entire fiscal year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates are projecting earnings of $24.93 per share and a revenue of $206.63 billion, representing changes of +22.57% and +13.25%, respectively, from the prior year.

Investors should also take note of any recent adjustments to analyst estimates for JPMorgan Chase & Co. These revisions help to show the ever-changing nature of near-term business trends. With this in mind, we can consider positive estimate revisions a sign of optimism about the business outlook.

Based on our research, we believe these estimate revisions are directly related to near-term stock moves. To exploit this, we've formed the Zacks Rank, a quantitative model that includes these estimate changes and presents a viable rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, stretching from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), has a noteworthy track record of outperforming, validated by third-party audits, with stocks rated #1 producing an average annual return of +25% since the year 1988. Over the last 30 days, the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has witnessed a 3.82% increase. As of now, JPMorgan Chase & Co. holds a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy).

In the context of valuation, JPMorgan Chase & Co. is at present trading with a Forward P/E ratio of 14.57. Its industry sports an average Forward P/E of 15.09, so one might conclude that JPMorgan Chase & Co. is trading at a discount comparatively.

Meanwhile, JPM's PEG ratio is currently 1.46. This metric is used similarly to the famous P/E ratio, but the PEG ratio also takes into account the stock's expected earnings growth rate. The average PEG ratio for the Financial - Investment Bank industry stood at 1.04 at the close of the market yesterday.

The Financial - Investment Bank industry is part of the Finance sector. With its current Zacks Industry Rank of 42, this industry ranks in the top 18% of all industries, numbering over 250.

The Zacks Industry Rank is ordered from best to worst in terms of the average Zacks Rank of the individual companies within each of these sectors. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

Keep in mind to rely on Zacks.com to watch all these stock-impacting metrics, and more, in the succeeding trading sessions.

chineseTitle: 尽管市场上涨，摩根大通 (JPM) 股价仍下跌：需要注意的重要事实
chineseSummary: 摩根大通(JPM)最新交易日收盘价达到357.26美元，较上一交易日收盘价上涨-1.65%。
chineseContent:
摩根大通 (JPM) 在最新交易日收于 357.26 美元，较前一交易日上涨 -1.65%。该股的涨幅低于标准普尔 500 指数 0.21% 的日涨幅。其他方面，道指上涨 0.22%，而以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数则上涨 0.16%。

在今天的交易之前，该公司股价上涨了 5.22%，超过了金融板块 1.78% 的涨幅和标准普尔 500 指数 3.25% 的涨幅。

投资界将密切关注摩根大通即将发布的盈利表现。该公司每股收益（EPS）预计为5.83美元，较去年同期增长14.99%。此外，我们最近的一致预测是预计收入为 515.1 亿美元，比去年同期增长 10.94%。

对于整个财年，Zacks 一致预期预计每股收益为 24.93 美元，营收为 2066.3 亿美元，较上一年分别变化 +22.57% 和 +13.25%。

投资者还应注意摩根大通分析师预测的近期调整。这些调整有助于显示近期业务趋势不断变化的性质。考虑到这一点，我们可以认为积极的估计修正是对业务前景乐观的迹象。

根据我们的研究，我们认为这些估计修正与近期股票走势直接相关。为了利用这一点，我们形成了 Zacks Rank，这是一个定量模型，其中包括这些估计变化并提供了一个可行的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统从#1（强力买入）延伸到#5（强力卖出），拥有出色的表现记录，经第三方审计验证，自 1988 年以来，排名第一的股票产生的平均年回报率为 +25%。在过去 30 天里，Zacks 共识 EPS 估计增长了 3.82%。截至目前，摩根大通公司的 Zacks 排名为第二（购买）。

在估值方面，摩根大通目前的远期市盈率为14.57。该行业的平均远期市盈率为 15.09，因此人们可能会得出结论，摩根大通公司的交易价格相对较低。

与此同时，摩根大通的PEG比率目前为1.46。该指标的使用方式与著名的市盈率类似，但 PEG 比率还考虑了股票的预期盈利增长率。截至昨天收盘，金融-投资银行行业的平均 PEG 比率为 1.04。

金融-投资银行行业是金融行业的一部分。该行业目前 Zacks 行业排名第 42 位，在所有行业中排名前 18%，数量超过 250 个。

Zacks 行业排名是根据每个行业内各个公司的平均 Zacks 排名从最好到最差排序的。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
